source.boundary: Stock-based reorder for a DU at a DEPOT uses ROSIZ=2 and point STSIZ-ROSIZ=2. At a reorder position, omitted ISTOH defaults to STSIZ+AINST; explicit ISTOH changes initial physical stock only and must not be below the reorder point. Installed dictionary Item.TRACK collects item results and defaults to N; both arms now explicitly set TRACK=Y to expose station-specific ItemResults.

configuration.inherited_ordinary_demand: One fixed-seed aircraft DU failure near h9.8829, local replacement at h10, one depot spare issues toward base at h10; no direct repair for the discardable DU.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both frozen inputs and the accepted donor are source-bound. Only ProblemDescription, Item.TRACK=Y and the depot StockAllocation row change from the donor; the two E15 arms differ only in ProblemDescription and depot ISTOH. The 21 populated authored tables round-trip exactly.

Each guarded session-0 SSH run finishes import, export, calc, JSON report and checker with zero exits, zero converter errors, valid nonempty SXO and report, expected logging warning only, and preserved GUI PID 13340.

Both arms retain the donor's single aircraft DU failure, h10 local issue and discard, h10 depot-to-base issue, h12 base replenishment, mission outcomes and terminal aircraft readiness; physical identities are reconciled per arm.

Default ISTOH gives depot opening on-hand four; after one h10 depot issue its stock state is three, above reorder point two, with no reorder by h36. Explicit ISTOH=3 gives opening on-hand three; after the h10 depot issue stock state reaches two and initiates exactly one ROSIZ=2 reorder at h10, which delivers two newly identified DUs at h11 after LEADT=1 hour. If native timing differs, classify as a failed predeclared expectation and revise only in a fresh versioned run.

Selected station-specific ItemResults must be present with 72 half-hour bins in both arms and reconcile opening stock, one depot shipment, any reorder delivery, and terminal state. Stock/system summaries must also reconcile. Preserve original raw artifacts and seal hashes; a separate reviewer independently replays the frozen claims.

excluded_diagnostic.reason: The first paired runs produced the predicted events and valid default reports, but the predeclared selected station-specific ItemResults were absent because the donor's Item.TRACK was unset. Their later report probes are excluded from acceptance; this revision freezes TRACK=Y and requires a fresh paired native run.

limits: One fixed seed, one DU, one base/depot pair, stock-based ROSIZ=2, fixed one-hour lead, and one ordinary demand are in scope.

This pair does not establish time-based ROINT, multiple concurrent orders, random lead time, ISTOH at/below the reorder point, AINST, procurement after a planned transfer, other stations/seeds, GUI-only behavior or cross-engine parity.
It does not close E15, I02, I07 or Issue #18.
